title: Clarks invites Filipinos to discover their comfort moments with Cloudsteppers
summary: Clarks’ Philippine Cloudsteppers™ campaign invites customers to explore the collection through “Discover Your Comfort Moments” in stores nationwide and “Share Your Comfort Moments” on social media.…

blocks.text: Clarks’ Philippine Cloudsteppers™ campaign invites customers to explore the collection through “Discover Your Comfort Moments” in stores nationwide and “Share Your Comfort Moments” on social media. Purchases of any Cloudsteppers pair come with an exclusive Clarks tote bag, while supplies last.
